summary: Completed testing of Web Application Penetration Testing tool after backend restart. Frontend UI loads and renders correctly, but backend API has persistent performance issues causing timeouts during scan processing and history retrieval. Core functionality partially works but becomes unresponsive under load.

critical_bugs.issue: Backend becomes unresponsive during scan processing, likely due to blocking LLM API calls
critical_bugs.impact: Scan creation works but processing hangs, preventing completion of security scans

critical_bugs.issue: Scan history retrieval times out after initial requests work
critical_bugs.impact: History page shows infinite loading spinner, users cannot view past scans

performance_issues.issue: Claude Sonnet 4.5 API calls taking 60+ seconds and blocking server
performance_issues.symptoms: Server becomes unresponsive after processing requests with AI analysis

ui_bugs.issue: Button gets stuck in 'Initiating...' state when backend times out
Infinite loading spinner when backend API times out

integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot handle backend timeout gracefully
No timeout handling or error state for failed API calls

passed_tests: Frontend landing page loads correctly with proper styling
URL input field accepts user input and validation works
Feature cards and UI components have proper styling
Backend root API endpoint responds (after restart)
OWASP categories API endpoint works consistently
UI components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Backend performance issues persist. The LLM API calls (Claude Sonnet 4.5) are blocking the FastAPI server for 60+ seconds, causing timeouts. Recommendations: 1) Implement async/non-blocking LLM calls, 2) Add proper timeout handling, 3) Consider making AI analysis truly optional/background, 4) Add error handling for frontend when backend times out, 5) Implement request queuing or rate limiting for LLM calls.
